FN-98STPBM-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 167
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/18/2024
Senate Bill 167 as introduced could decrease future potential obligations of the Education Trust
Fund and the State General Fund, by undetermined amounts depending on the number of
Alabama Jobs Act approved or incentivized companies found to have violated the provisions of
this bill and the amount of incentives recaptured.

FN-98STPBM-3
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 167
Committee: Ways and Means Education Sponsor: Senator Merika Coleman
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/29/2024
Senate Bill 167 as passed the Senate could increase receipts to the Education Trust Fund and
the State General Fund by undetermined amounts dependent on the amount of Alabama Jobs
Act incentives recaptured from incentivized companies found to have violated the provisions of
this bill.
